race_id.description: BallotReady brHashId. Trace / idempotency identifier only - the agent does NOT reason over it.

user_full_name.description: The candidate we write FOR. Referred to as 'you' in output, never by name.

mode.description: initial = first full generation; weekly = re-prioritize the upcoming week using prior_tasks.

today.description: Reference date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the upcoming-week window and the GOTV reframe.

election_date.description: General election date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null. Drives the last-30-days GOTV reframe.

state.description: 2-letter state code, for local event search.

city.description: City / locality name, for local event search.

campaign_plan.description: The candidate's generated campaign plan (summary text) for personalization context.

campaign_story.description: The candidate's story for personalization context.

task_catalog.description: The dynamic task menu. The agent SELECTS and PERSONALIZES from this list and never invents new task types. Each item is a candidate Active/GOTV task.

prior_tasks.description: Previously generated dynamic tasks with completion status (weekly mode). Empty on initial. Used to push incomplete-but-important tasks forward and avoid repeating same-type tasks.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the agent emits when it writes the artifact.

tasks.description: The week's top tasks in priority order (most important first), at most 12. At most 3 may be events (kind='event'). Tasks (kind='task') reference a task_catalog id.

catalog_id.description: task_catalog id for kind='task'; null for events.

channel.description: Catalog channel for tasks; 'event' for events.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The event date for kind='event'; null for undated tasks.

address.description: Event venue address; null for tasks or when not found.
